title: Verve Holiday Blend 2026 review: a seasonal filter coffee with an espresso path
description: Research-led US Verve Holiday Blend 2026 review: current Guatemala–Ethiopia composition, Verve and Fellow brew starts, attributed flavor notes, seasonal limits and buying fit.
imageAlt: Verve Coffee Roasters 2026 Holiday Blend red 12-ounce bag
imageCredit: Verve Coffee Roasters official 2026 12-ounce Holiday Blend package image, checked November 12, 2026. This is product identification, not Coffeedant tasting photography.
price: Check current US Holiday Blend whole-bean checkout total
verdict: Verve's 2026 Holiday Blend is a focused seasonal trial for a buyer who wants a light, fruit-accented filter cup and may also make espresso. Its current record names washed Guatemala Antigua and natural Ethiopia Guji, with a 25:375 Dwell start. Fellow independently tasted a current sample and published separate pour-over and espresso recipes. Orange zest, candied chestnut and pine are attributed tasting words, not Coffeedant results. Buy a dated 12 oz whole-bean bag first; neither an earlier Holiday Blend nor a bulk size proves this season's cup will suit you.
bestFor: Light-roast drinkers wanting a seasonal Guatemala–Ethiopia blend
Filter households with a Dwell or another flat-bottom brewer
Buyers willing to dial a separate espresso recipe from current Fellow guidance
skipIf: You want a stable year-round blend with fixed components
You prefer a dark, chocolate-led coffee with little fruit interest
You need an independently verified taste or roast date for the bag you have not received
authorNote: I checked Verve's current product and shipping record against Fellow's current independent tasting and older owner context. Coffeedant has not bought, brewed or tasted the 2026 Holiday Blend.

sections.title: This season's two-component blend
paragraphs: Verve's current Holiday Blend pairs washed coffee from Guatemala's Antigua Valley with naturally processed coffee from Ethiopia's Guji region. It describes smallholder producers, the Guatemalan component above 1,400 metres and Ethiopian drying on raised beds for up to 20 days. The page lists various cultivars and a light 4/10 roast; it does not give a fixed cultivar for each future bag. Fellow's November 2026 account describes the same two origins, which helps date the identity of this season's release. [1] [3]

Holiday Blend is seasonal and the 2026 red package shown here is whole bean, not Verve's separate Holiday Blend craft-instant six-pack. Earlier guides and owner posts discuss older holiday compositions, so their crop names and tasting comments cannot be imported into this bag. Buy the current named product and record the roast date on arrival before assuming a repeat order will be identical next season. [1] [2] [7]

sections.title: Orange zest and chestnut are attributed notes
paragraphs: Verve's current coffee collection lists orange zest, candied chestnut and pine. Fellow's coffee team reports those notes from its own 2026 sample and describes the washed Antigua and natural Guji combination as both vibrant and rounded. Fellow sells brewing equipment and coffee, so its account is a useful separate sample, not a blind panel or guarantee for a later roast. Coffeedant has not tasted this bag or assigned a sensory score. [2] [3]

An older owner found a previous Verve Holiday Blend somewhat too acidic while still enjoyable. A 2024 holiday guide and even older owner discussions show the blend name has a history, but their components and cups may differ. That is a reason to begin with a small current pack if bright notes are uncertain, not evidence that 2026 beans have the same acidity. [7] [8]

sections.title: Start with Verve's Dwell or Fellow's matched recipe
paragraphs: Verve publishes a Dwell dripper start of 25 g coffee to 375 g water, a 1:15 ratio, with a medium grind and around 2:40 total time. Fellow's sample guide offers a separate flat-bottom pour-over start of 18 g to 280 g at 198°F, about 1:15.5. These are starting points for different flat-bottom devices, not Coffeedant measured extractions. Keep the brewer and filter fixed as you adjust grind or ratio according to your own cup. [1] [3]

Fellow also gives a Series 1 espresso start of 18 g in to 36 g out at 200°F with a target around 30 seconds, and a slightly longer milk-drink suggestion. Those settings describe Fellow's equipment and tested sample. A different machine, basket, grinder and roast date may require another dial-in. Do not use the 1:15 Dwell water ratio for a pump espresso shot. [3]

sections.title: Use the season and the roast date
paragraphs: The official product currently lists 12 oz, 2.2 lb and 5 lb sizes with whole-bean or grind options, and says coffees are roasted to order. Verve's FAQ describes weekday shipping and timing limits. Those statements are about direct fulfillment and do not prove the roast date of a retail shelf bag or that every size remains available. Read the actual bag date, keep whole beans sealed away from heat and moisture, and grind close to brewing. [1] [4]

Fellow suggests roughly 10–14 days of rest for the sample it brewed. Treat that as one current tasting team's starting observation, not a universal peak date. A small 12 oz bag gives a bounded comparison before a seasonal 2.2 lb or 5 lb commitment; a large pack makes sense only if the household consumes it while it still tastes good to them. [1] [3]

sections.title: A seasonal bag is valuable only if you use it
paragraphs: The official page showed a US headline price and several size choices at this check, but the accessible text does not firmly pair the number with a selected whole-bean size, shipping and taxes. This review therefore makes no numeric price, discount or per-cup promise. Compare a selected 12 oz one-time order and any larger size in the live cart, including delivery and subscription conditions. [1] [4]

The useful premium is current origin detail plus a Verve filter recipe and Fellow's separate 2026 sample-tested routes. That does not make the coffee a better daily buy for a person who dislikes fruit-accented light roasts. If the season's novelty is the reason for purchase, order what you can actually finish; do not buy five pounds just because the unit price looks lower. [1] [2] [3]

sections.title: Compare a year-round Verve blend by drink
paragraphs: Verve Aster is an existing medium-roast, fruit-directed review with separate filter and espresso starts; it is a year-round comparison if a seasonal restock is inconvenient. Seabright is a medium filter-first house blend with a fruit-and-hazelnut brief. Bronson French Roast moves deliberately toward a darker, chocolate-led press or drip direction. None is a tasting-equivalent substitute for the 2026 Holiday bag. [5] [6] [9]

For a holiday gift, ask whether the recipient brews whole beans and likes light, fruit-oriented coffee before choosing this over Verve's instant format. A current roast date, matching grind equipment and manageable bag size matter more than the seasonal label alone. [1] [2]

faqs.question: Which origins are in the 2026 Holiday Blend?
faqs.answer: Verve currently names washed Guatemala Antigua and natural Ethiopia Guji. Earlier holiday seasons may differ.

faqs.question: Is this a dark roast?
faqs.answer: No. Verve labels the current Holiday Blend light, 4/10 on its scale.

faqs.question: What does it taste like?
faqs.answer: Verve lists orange zest, candied chestnut and pine, and Fellow reported those notes from its sample. Coffeedant has not tasted the 2026 bag.

faqs.question: What filter recipe does Verve publish?
faqs.answer: Its Dwell start is 25 g coffee to 375 g water, about 1:15, with a medium grind and roughly 2:40 total time.

faqs.question: Can I use Holiday Blend for espresso?
faqs.answer: Fellow published a 2026 sample recipe of 18 g in to 36 g out on its Series 1. Dial in your own machine and grinder separately from the filter recipe.

faqs.question: Should I order a large bag?
faqs.answer: Start with a roast-dated 12 oz whole-bean bag if this season's light flavor profile is new to you; larger listed sizes suit households that will finish them while fresh.
